decisions.reason: The exact LED model, manufacturer, part number, color format, pad count, and package details are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Selecting the SK6812MINI-E package does not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, channel count, or current-monitor placement.
The LED part selection does not change standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, or the scope powered from the 3.3V rail.
The charge-status behavior continues to use the main-board SK6812 chain; the exact LED package selection does not change its indicator routing, GPIO, connector, or resistor requirements.
The LED model and package selection does not alter any interboard connector type, signal assignment, power signal, or matching-pin-order rule.
The selected LED component does not change the 3.3V source OR-ing method, source selection behavior, or power-supply diode requirement.
The source specifies an LED part and package but does not change the existing main-board local-decoupling requirement.
The LED model selection does not affect panel buttons, switches, reset wiring, touch inputs, BOOT placement, or capacitance.
The 5V boost requirement already covers LEDs and their logic as loads; choosing the exact SK6812 model does not change boost enable control, output current, or load-category semantics.
The exact LED part does not add, remove, or alter any main-board connector or connector-count requirement.
The source identifies an LED component but establishes no change to any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The SK6812 component selection is unrelated to the I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
